notes: M7 part c: the 104 content files NLAlib/Matrix/[R-Z]*.lean; Spectral.lean, Structured.lean and Subspaces.lean are generated aggregators and are not mapped.

Real Schur / real normal form / real QZ family (RealInvariant*, RealNormal*, RealSchur*, RealPlaneSchur, RealPencilTriangularization, RealQZ, RealSpectrumSchur, Real*Descent) and complex Schur triangularization family (SchurTriangularization, SchurDensity, SchurFrobenius, SchurToolkit, SmallTriangularSimilarity, SeparableCharpolyDensity) -> Spectral, per the brief's Schur* (triangularisation) hint.
Simultaneous* plus SemidefiniteCongruence (simultaneous congruence diagonalization) -> Spectral.
Singular-value infrastructure (SingularValue*, SingularIsometries, SingularInterlacing*, SquareSingularBasis, SigmaMinTransport, RealDilation*) -> Spectral.

Sylvester equation, qualitative (SylvesterQualitative/Blocks/Similarity/Toolkit, Horn-Johnson 2.4) -> Spectral; Sylvester criterion (SylvesterCriterion, SylvesterCriterionToolkit) -> Spectral beside Inertia/PrincipalMinors; quantitative Sylvester.lean (Bhatia VII.2 separation bound, consumed by DavisKahan and CoupledNormBounds) -> Perturbation.

Schatten family, SymmetricGauge and RectangularDiagonal* (gauge-permutation support consumed only by InvariantNormRepresentation) -> Norms: the docstrings are norm definitions/axioms/Hoelder/duality (atlas schatten-norms-def, unitarily-invariant-norm-def).
Schur.lean (Schur diagonal majorization + Peierls) and the SchurHorn* family -> Inequalities (majorization, atlas schur-horn).

Wedin* plus their only-consumer support SingularFrames/SingularFrameTails -> Perturbation; SpectralWeightGap/SpectralFrameWeights (Yu-Wang-Samworth Davis-Kahan support, consumed by EigenframeDecomposition/PopulationTraceGap) -> Perturbation.

SimpleEigenvalue* -> Perturbation (atlas simple-eigenvalue-perturbation, implicit-function eigenvalue branches); RayleighDerivative/ResidualBounds (atlas eigenvalue-residual-bounds, Kato-Temple) -> Perturbation.
No file in this part imports anything outside Matrix/ and ForMathlib/; all are layer-0 clean. No base-name collisions with existing leaf files, so no renames.
flags: NLAlib/Matrix/SimpleEigenvalue*.lean (8 files): brief hint says Spectral; docstrings are eigenvalue-branch perturbation theory (Horn-Johnson 6.3.12), so placed in Perturbation beside SpectralContinuity. Revisit if the lead prefers the hint.

NLAlib/Matrix/Schatten*.lean (10 files), SymmetricGauge.lean, RectangularDiagonal*.lean: brief hint says Inequalities/Spectral for Schatten; placed in Norms. Parts a/b should send InvariantNorm*, KyFanNorms/KyFanNormToolkit, NuclearNorm* to the same leaf, or these should follow wherever they go.

NLAlib/Matrix/SpectrumCount.lean, SpectrumCountContinuity.lean: placed in Spectral; only consumer is GershgorinCounting (part a/b) -- keep the Gershgorin family in the same leaf (Spectral) or move these with it.

NLAlib/Matrix/UnitaryBlockCompletion.lean: completion step of the CS decomposition (only consumer ComplexCSDecomposition); placed in Subspaces assuming the CS*/CanonicalCS family goes there. Must follow the CS family's leaf (Subspaces vs Factorizations) chosen in part a.

NLAlib/Matrix/ScaledOrthogonal.lean: nearest scaled orthogonal matrix (Procrustes family; consumer ProcrustesToolkit); placed in Subspaces beside PolarFrame assuming Procrustes*/NearestPolar/Polar* go there. Must follow the Procrustes family's leaf chosen in parts a/b.
NLAlib/Matrix/RectangularGramIsometry.lean: completes GramIsometry (atlas gram-equality-isometry); placed in Basic beside Gram/GramVanishing. Should follow GramIsometry/ComplexGramIsometry (part a).

NLAlib/Matrix/SemidefiniteCongruence.lean: simultaneous congruence of PSD pairs; placed in Spectral with Simultaneous*; DefiniteCongruence/IndefiniteCongruence/CongruenceToolkit (part a) should match.
NLAlib/Matrix/SeparatingPSDVector.lean: PSD rank-one certificate whose only consumer is FiniteExponentialGram (Hadamard exponential family); placed in Inequalities assuming Hadamard* go there.

NLAlib/Matrix/Schur.lean: in Inequalities the bare name `Schur` is uninformative (content is Schur diagonal majorization + Peierls); a rename such as SchurMajorization would be reasonable under rule 2(b), not recorded because this part keeps base names except on collisions.

NLAlib/Matrix/Sylvester.lean vs Sylvester{Qualitative,Blocks,Similarity,Toolkit}: split across Perturbation (separation bound) and Spectral (solvability/disjoint spectra) because they are distinct atlas families (sylvester-separation-bound vs sylvester-equation).
